URL: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9700

Use this security baseline to limit token consequences: restrict access-token audiences and privileges, use authorization code flow with PKCE where applicable, and protect refresh tokens with client binding, rotation, or sender constraint. Its audience rule specifically requires a resource server to reject a token intended for a different resource server.
